requirements.text: build_remediation_maturation.build() reads research/architecture_health/LATEST_AUTOMATION_HEALTH.json without checking whether the live GitHub audit actually ran. A report built without a token has api_error set and every workflow finding WORKFLOW_NOT_REGISTERED_OR_API_UNAVAILABLE / NO_RUN_HISTORY, so real findings vanish (counted as post-fix successes for IN_REMEDIATION/POST_FIX items) and blind findings mint new tasks. Make maturation fail closed on such input: when api_error is set or the report lacks live run data for most scheduled workflows, carry the prior queue forward unchanged, record the refusal reason, and do not increment post_fix_successes or create signatures from API-unavailability findings.
A health report with api_error set leaves every prior item state and post_fix_successes unchanged and records a refusal reason.
A normal token-bearing report still matures findings exactly as before (existing tests pass).
No finding WORKFLOW_NOT_REGISTERED_OR_API_UNAVAILABLE becomes CODEX_READY when api_error is set.
No change to thresholds, risk classes or post-fix gate counts for valid input.
No workflow trigger or schedule changes.
